reserve.infoOk:
Swedish lane points match:
Tactical substitutions must be made at the start of the series. If a player is injured, the reserve player continues on that player's score sheet.
Substitutions can be made at any time from the front desk if other rules apply.
reserve.infoLocked:
Note! The player has already bowled and cannot be substituted.
From the lane console, only tactical substitutions can be made, at the start of the series. Substitutions can be made at any time from the front desk.
